INVARIANT_REQUIRED_BEHAVIOR: leftover success-tranche remaining>0 and not expired must keep campaign_usable true and overlay usable true even when created_at is older than 90d lookback and pool=0
INVARIANT_FORBIDDEN_BEHAVIOR: 90d lookback cutoff must not AND-stop a living leftover; must not drop leftover via created_at>=now-90d so campaign_usable becomes false when remaining>0 not expired and pool=0
INVARIANT_ENTRY_CONDITIONS: leftover success-tranche remaining>0, not expired, created_at older than PROMO_LOOKBACK_DAYS (90d), pool=0
INVARIANT_SCOPE: promo_ledger leftover usable lookback campaign overlay campaign_usable pool
